info.title: Suisse Line API
info.description:
REST API for managing AI phone agents and automated campaigns on the Suisse Line platform.

## Authentication
All endpoints require authentication via one of the following methods:
- **API Key**: Include `X-API-Key` header with your API key
- **Bearer Token**: Include `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header
- **Cookie**: Session cookie `accessToken` (web application)

## Base URL
Production: `https://app.suisse-line.ch`

## Rate Limits
API requests are limited to 100 requests per minute per user.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: API key for programmatic access (format: sv_...)

ProbeTokenAuth.description:
Per-agent read-only probe token (`sv_probe_*`). Scoped to exactly one
phone agent and only valid for the availability endpoint. Create one via
`POST /api/phone-agent/{id}/probe-tokens` (account API key or dashboard
session). Safe to embed in PBX-side scripts.

firstSpeaker.description: Who speaks first when call connects

defaultLanguage.description: Initial AI language (e.g., de-CH, en, fr)

realtimeTurnDetection.description: Turn detection mode. contextual = the agent judges from what was said whether the caller has finished; silence = a pause ends the turn. Older names are still accepted when writing.

voiceId.description: Voice identifier (e.g., lukas, stefan, anna, lea). An individual voice without one of these names reads as "custom"; sending "custom" back keeps it.

condition.description: When to forward (e.g., "when caller wants to speak to sales")

warmTransfer.description: Enable warm transfer (AI summarizes before connecting)

fallbackRingTimeout.description: Seconds to ring before trying next number

EmailTemplates.description:
Your own HTML templates for the call summary e-mail. A template is the whole e-mail: styles, media queries and
Outlook conditional comments are kept. The platform reads the values of its placeholders (names in double
curly braces) from the call, fills them HTML-escaped and sends the template as it is. Off unless `enabled` is
true. Leave the field out to keep the stored templates; `null` removes them. A routing rule may name the
template for its e-mails (`template`, the key).

instructions.description: How to fill the values; used instead of `prompt` for e-mails written in a template

when.description: When the template fits a call; required for every template but the default when several can be chosen

default.description: Used when no other template fits (exactly one when several can be chosen)

requestedPerson.description: Only for the e-mail to the person the caller asked for, never chosen otherwise

html.description: The whole e-mail; no scripts, frames, forms or event handlers

set.description: Values of other placeholders that go with this option (e.g. colours)

silenceTimeoutSeconds.description: Auto-disconnect after N seconds of silence

idleMessages.description: Messages the agent speaks during silence (automatically translated into the caller's current conversation language)

smartTurnDetectionEnabled.description: Smart turn detection (fewer interruptions). The older name of this field is still accepted when writing.

emergencyFallbackEnabled.description: Transfer to human if agent fails

name.description: Tool name for AI to reference

WebhookPayloadFields.description: Fields to include in webhook payloads

endReason.description: endReason (the stored reason) and endReasonCode (one of customer_hangup, agent_hangup, forwarded, forward_failed, silence_timeout, max_duration, no_answer, connection_failed, voicemail, rate_limited, completed, system). Use endReasonCode; endReason keeps its values for existing integrations.

callRef.description: Reference of the call's media session. It replaces an earlier field name, which integrations that enabled it keep receiving next to callRef until they are told otherwise.

totalChars.description: Total character count of extracted text

processingError.description: Why processing failed (too_large = too much text for one file)

allowedDomains.description: Domains allowed to embed the widget (empty = all)

isBrowserTest.description: Whether this was a browser test call

put.summary: Move an agent into a folder
put.description:
Sets the folder label that groups the agent in the agent list, e.g. "Burkhalter Gruppe / Lauber IWISA"
(at most 3 levels joined by " / ", at most 120 characters). The folder belongs to the agent: its owner and
everyone it is shared with see the same grouping. Does not change the agent's configuration (no new version,
no redeploy). Allowed for the owner and for shared users with the ADMIN role. `null` or "" removes the folder.

200.description: Folder saved (changed = false if it was already set)

403.description: The share role may not edit the agent

post.description:
Renames a folder and its sub-folders on every agent the caller may edit (owned, or shared with the ADMIN role).
`to: null` removes the folder; sub-folders move up one level.

400.description: Invalid folder name, or the rename would exceed the folder depth

get.summary: Check whether a phone agent can take a call
get.description:
Lightweight availability probe intended for PBX routing scripts (e.g. 3CX)
that need to decide whether to send a call to the agent. Authenticates with
a per-agent, read-only `sv_probe_*` token — NOT the account API key — sent as
`Authorization: Bearer sv_probe_...` (or `X-Probe-Token` header).

Availability is computed from live signals (agent exists and is not deleted,
phone number assigned, SIP trunk active for BYO numbers, AI worker process
online, SIP edge running) — not from a database status label.

Rate limit: 120 requests/minute.

parameters.name: agentRef
parameters.description: Numeric agent id (e.g. `774`) or the agent's publicId.

checks.description: Individual signals. `null` = not applicable / could not be determined.

404.description: No agent matching this probe token
